A '''drag course''' used for [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] existed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Toy Dampner]] was favored on this course, and he would challenge other racers to compete against him.<ref name="E1R" />

==Behind the scenes==
The course first appeared, unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Game Boy|Gameboy Color]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''.
